author: Claude (handoff 118)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any cost transaction is fetched and before any scenario value exists.
purpose: Freeze the sampling rule, the stopping rule, the exact cost decomposition, the exclusion accounting and the scenario derivation for a contemporaneous execution-cost calibration built from observed successful Pump buys.

what_this_is_not.headline: Observed costs of OTHER traders are calibration evidence. They are not a guarantee that any route we might choose would land, and they are not a price we are promised.
consequences: every scenario is labelled SIMULATED_SHADOW and is non-executable
no transaction is constructed, simulated or sent at any point
a quantile of what others paid is not a quote

semantics_taken: base fee is 5,000 lamports per signature
prioritization fee is ceil(compute_unit_price_micro_lamports * compute_unit_limit / 1000000) lamports
the prioritization fee uses the REQUESTED compute unit limit, not the units consumed
default compute unit limit is 200,000 per instruction; maximum 1,400,000 per transaction
primary_sources.not_answered_by_the_source: whether meta.fee in getTransaction includes both components
primary_sources.how_that_is_resolved: EMPIRICALLY, from this sample: for every transaction where both components are independently derivable, base + prioritization is compared against meta.fee and the agreement rate is published. A documented claim would be weaker than the arithmetic.

semantics_taken: TradeEvent publishes fee, fee_basis_points, creator_fee, creator_fee_basis_points, cashback, cashback_fee_basis_points, buyback_fee and buyback_fee_basis_points as exact integers

population.definition: a transaction is IN POPULATION when it carries no error and at least one Pump TradeEvent with is_buy true
population.outcome_independence: membership is decided by the transaction's own content only. No outcome, no price move, no profit figure and no later state may influence it — and none exists in this system to influence it with.
population.identity: the transaction signature; a signature appears at most once

sampling_rule.selector: include the signature when int(sha256('b15c:' + signature).hexdigest(), 16) % sampling_modulus == 0
sampling_rule.why_not_first_n: taking the first N in canonical order samples the earliest minutes of the feed, and fees move with congestion. A hash sample is time-neutral and reproducible from the signature alone.
sampling_rule.why_deterministic: a seeded RNG would make the sample depend on a library's implementation; integer arithmetic on a hash cannot drift between versions

stopping_rule.extension_forbidden_reason: a sample enlarged after its quantiles were seen is a sample whose size was chosen by the quantiles

cost_components.name: prioritization_fee_lamports
cost_components.available_only_when: both the limit and the price instructions are present

cost_components.name: tip_lamports
cost_components.evidence_rule: a System Program transfer whose destination is in an EXPLICITLY DECLARED tip-account set

cost_components.name: backfill_latency_ns
cost_components.source: this worker's own monotonic clock around the request

zero_by_absence_is_forbidden.rule: a component that is not published by the evidence is UNAVAILABLE and is recorded as such with a reason. It is never recorded as zero.
zero_by_absence_is_forbidden.why: zero is a measurement meaning 'this cost was not incurred'. Absent means 'we cannot say'. A transaction with no SetComputeUnitPrice instruction pays no prioritization fee, but a transaction whose instructions we failed to parse might have paid a large one, and the two must not share a value.

distinguished.no_compute_budget_instruction_present: prioritization_fee is 0 AND provably so, because the fee is defined by those instructions and their absence is evidence
distinguished.instructions_present_but_undecodable: prioritization_fee is UNAVAILABLE with reason C03

decomposition_check.on_disagreement: the row is recorded with reason C05_decomposition_mismatch and is EXCLUDED from the scenario sample; it is not adjusted to fit
decomposition_check.why_published: the agreement rate is the empirical answer to what meta.fee contains, and a decomposition that never disagrees is one nobody checked

exclusion_codes.meaning: no Pump TradeEvent with is_buy true
a ComputeBudget instruction is present but its data did not parse
bounded retries used without a response
base plus prioritization did not equal meta.fee
signature or slot in the response disagrees with the recorded frame

exclusion_accounting: every exclusion is counted by code and published. A sample that reports only what it kept is a sample nobody can size.

scenario_derivation.derived_from: the observed distribution of total_fee_lamports over the included sample
scenario_derivation.statistic_rule: exact integer order statistics by index, no interpolation between neighbours
scenario_derivation.why_no_interpolation: an interpolated quantile invents a value no transaction actually paid
scenario_derivation.outcome_tuning_structurally_impossible: no outcome, realised return or profit figure exists anywhere in B15a or B15b, so there is nothing for a scenario to be tuned against. This is stated as a fact about the system, not as a promise about conduct.

hypothetical_route_vs_observed.rule: the observed cost of another trader's transaction is NOT the cost of a route we might choose
hypothetical_route_vs_observed.our_route_is: unpriced. No route is constructed, and no landing probability is claimed at any quantile.

may_not_write: every file in the B11c integrity manifest
isolation.concurrency: B15a and B15b keep running; both are read through immutable evidence or read-only snapshots

strictly_forbidden: wallet or key material of any kind
tips, priority fees, or any spending
inferring a missing cost component as zero
letting any outcome, return or profit figure influence a scenario
extending the sample after seeing its quantiles
claiming a landing probability or an executable price
